ValidationRule.description: QA fix (Defect #2): blocks direct edit of these 3 approval-status fields to Approved/Rejected, bypassing the real Approval Process. Approval-process field updates run outside VR evaluation, so real approvals are unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISCHANGED(AF_CancellationApprovalStatus__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(AF_CancellationApprovalStatus__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(AF_CancellationApprovalStatus__c, "Rejected")) ), AND( ISCHANGED(AF_LostApprovalStatus__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(AF_LostApprovalStatus__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(AF_LostApprovalStatus__c, "Rejected")) ), AND( ISCHANGED(AF_RequisitionStatus__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(AF_RequisitionStatus__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(AF_RequisitionStatus__c, "Rejected")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This approval status field can only change to Approved or Rejected through its real Approval Process (Submit, then Approve/Reject) - not by direct edit.
